confirm.title: Enable {{name}}?
confirm.warning: It runs inside Auto Tournament's server with full access to your database, files and secrets, and inside the browser of every admin and player who opens a page it draws, with their permissions. Auto Tournament does not review or sandbox code modules. Enable it only if you trust its author as much as you trust this platform.

highlightsPage.title: Highlights
highlightsPage.subtitle: Highlight clips and reels from every match: what the recorders make, the music under the reels, and each game's recorders.

watermark.label: Auto Tournament logo on highlight videos
watermark.description: Shown faintly in the lower right. Leaving it on helps us a lot.

perPlayer.label: Clips per player per map
perPlayer.helper: 1 to 6. Each takes the recorder about five minutes, so fewer clips are ready sooner.

quality.helper: Smaller and fewer frames record faster: 720p at 30 fps takes about half as long as 1440p at 120 fps. Clips already made keep their size.

music.label: Music under reels
music.byo: Bring your own music: add tracks you have the rights to use. Auto Tournament ships none. The player plays a different one beside each reel, and downloads come with or without it.
music.source: Where it is from (a link, for credit)
music.contentIdLabel: Registered with YouTube Content ID (an upload with it can get a claim)
music.rights: Only add music you have the rights to use in videos. Its loudness is evened out with the other tracks.
music.suggestions_one: {{count}} track that fits reels, on Pixabay
music.suggestions_other: {{count}} tracks that fit reels, on Pixabay
music.suggestionsHelp: Open one, download it from Pixabay under its license, and add it here. The license lets you use it in videos; it does not let anyone pass the file on.
music.link: Or a link to the audio file

overlay.label: Overlays
overlay.helper_one: {{count}} clip has a clean copy. Redraw puts the current caption card, kill feed and names on it again, then makes the reels again. No CS2 needed.
overlay.helper_other: {{count}} clips have a clean copy. Redraw puts the current caption card, kill feed and names on them again, then makes the reels again. No CS2 needed.
overlay.keepCleanHelper: Each clip is also stored as recorded, without the card or kill feed. Reels are then made from the clean clips with an overlay of their own, and overlays can be redrawn. Off uses about half the storage.
